compiled_state.description:
Add the core built-in plan-review criterion T15 "overlay-derisk". Stack-agnostic; LLM-routed on plan content via `overlay_routing: llm`, dispatched by the review orchestrator exactly like T13/T14 (there is no ticket-tag routing). The full rubric is specified verbatim below so the artifact can be authored without resolving any other ticket.

Note on two distinct fields: the routing-entry `exec` uses the descriptor value "AGENT"; the rubric FRONT-MATTER `execution_mode` uses the prompt-loader enum value `agentic` (valid values are single_turn|agentic — "AGENT" is NOT valid front-matter and will fail the loader).

## Rubric to write verbatim into src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_T15.md
YAML front-matter: `title: Overlay de-risk — prove risky mechanisms out-of-loop`, `category: plan-review-criterion`, `execution_mode: agentic`, `dimension: overlay-derisk`.
`title:` is REQUIRED, not decorative: `build_descriptor` computes `name = prompt.title or cid`, so a rubric with no `title` degrades the criterion's rendered name to the bare id `T15` in both the guide header and `rebar explain T15`. AC #4 (which requires `rebar explain T15` to print the criterion name) would then pass only degenerately, and T15 would read differently from every sibling (T13 'Behavioral-prohibition consumer scan', T14 'CI-trigger / release-infrastructure coverage audit').
Body:

OVERLAY — apply only when ALL of the following hold; else PASS not-applicable.
- S1 Codified loop? the mechanism is delivered/validated by pushing through an automated pipeline or an environment/infrastructure apply, not by running or unit-testing code directly.
- S2 Slow or costly pass? one pass through that loop is slow (minutes-to-hours) or otherwise costly to run.
- S3 Runtime-only correctness? the change introduces behavior whose correctness only resolves when it actually runs in a realistic environment (boots, authenticates, connects, is authorized, passes readiness) — unreachable by static/unit checks.

When applicable, report a finding for each check not satisfied:
- (a) RISK NAMED — the plan identifies the specific mechanism(s) confirmable only by completing the full loop.
- (b) FAST OUT-OF-LOOP PROOF — for each named risk, the plan commits to proving it via the fastest feedback path available for that mechanism, outside the slow loop: running the unit locally/emulated where feasible, OR a manual experiment directly against the real target (an interactive call, a one-off CLI/console action, a probe script, a throwaway resource) where local reproduction isn't possible. The experiment is concrete and returns a verdict in minutes, not a delivery cycle. An unnamed "we'll verify" / "we'll check after deploy" does not satisfy it.
- (c) PROVE-THEN-CODIFY — the cheap experiment comes before committing the mechanism into the slow loop, so the loop validates an already-proven mechanism.
- (d) SCOPED CLEANUP — throwaway experiments are cleaned up afterward, with teardown that removes ONLY the artifacts the experiment itself created (the records a probe inserted, the scratch resource it spun up) and touches nothing pre-existing, shared, or persistent; a cleanup step that could delete, reset, or truncate a resource the experiment did not create (e.g. dropping an existing table or wiping a bucket to "reset" it) fails this check.

ANTI-FP: a manual experiment against the real target is a fully valid proof — never penalize choosing it over local reproduction; many stacks cannot be reproduced locally. A mechanism already proven elsewhere in the codebase needn't be re-proven.

## Routing entry to add to src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json (key "T15")
- `exec`: "AGENT"
- `facet`: "overlay-derisk"
- `overlay_routing`: "llm"  (orchestrator-dispatched content routing, as T13/T14)
- `applies_at`: { "suppress_types": ["bug"] }
- Posture/threshold: NOT set here — inherit the registry default (advisory). Advisory-vs-blocking is decided by the normal registry/review process, out of scope for this ticket.

## Implementation steps
1. Create src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_T15.md with the front-matter (execution_mode: agentic) + body above.
2. Add the "T15" routing entry above to src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json.
3. Add "T15" to CANONICAL_LLM in src/rebar/llm/plan_review/registry.py.
4. Regenerate the guide: `python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry regenerate-criteria-guide` (updates docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md).

## Scope boundary
This ticket authors the criterion artifact + registration + regenerated guide only. Runtime routing/finder BEHAVIOR (does T15 fire on an infra plan and stay silent on an app-only plan) is proven by the eval-fixtures story 36ab-b649-b72b-4608, which depends on this ticket — not asserted here.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_T15.md exists containing the S1-S3 gate, checks (a)-(d), and the ANTI-FP paragraph verbatim, with front-matter `execution_mode: agentic` and `dimension: overlay-derisk`. Verify: `python -c "import pathlib; s=pathlib.Path('src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_T15.md').read_text(); assert 'execution_mode: agentic' in s and 'dimension: overlay-derisk' in s and all(k in s for k in ['S1','S2','S3','RISK NAMED','FAST OUT-OF-LOOP PROOF','PROVE-THEN-CODIFY','SCOPED CLEANUP','ANTI-FP'])"` exits 0.
- [x] Routing entry has the required field VALUES (not just the key). Verify: `python -c "import json; e=json.load(open('src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json'))['T15']; assert e['exec']=='AGENT' and e['facet']=='overlay-derisk' and e['overlay_routing']=='llm' and e['applies_at']['suppress_types']==['bug'], e"` exits 0.
- [x] `python -c "from rebar.llm.plan_review.registry import CANONICAL_LLM; assert 'T15' in CANONICAL_LLM"` exits 0.
- [x] `rebar explain T15` prints the criterion name, exec tier AGENT, facet overlay-derisk, and the rubric body (S1-S3 + checks a-d).
- [x] Registry validators pass. Verify: `python -c "from rebar.llm.plan_review.registry import check_registry_coverage, validate_packaged_routing, validate_criteria_guide; ok,missing=check_registry_coverage(); assert ok, missing; assert not validate_packaged_routing(); assert not validate_criteria_guide()"` exits 0.
- [x] The regenerated guide contains the full T15 section (heading + checks). Verify: `python -c "s=open('docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md').read(); assert '## T15' in s and all(k in s for k in ['RISK NAMED','FAST OUT-OF-LOOP PROOF','PROVE-THEN-CODIFY','SCOPED CLEANUP'])"` exits 0.
